105 posts, rebuilt

Every image re-rendered on the new template engine, every WRONG claim from the audits corrected, every post rewritten person to person with no story openings. Text is live in the internal LinkedIn deck in edited_text.

Twelve layouts across seven surfaces: ivory, light blue, warm grey, navy, photo band, photo wash, photo column. Layout and surface rotate by day so no two consecutive posts match.

Three cards are marked in amber: those had an approved reviewer edit that I left in place rather than overwrite, so their image is new but their text is the reviewer's.
